title: Justice for Rural Communities Observatory — Pilot NTB & Jawa Barat (P1)
subtitle: Verified P1 public aggregates (BPS 2014-2026, Kemendesa Indeks Desa 2025, Court & OBH Directories) for NTB and Jawa Barat.
